definitions.meaning: Caller-supplied association of one variant and one price set with base-price records; no freshness or live link claim.
One identified base price in USD cents with inclusive quantity bounds; open bounds are represented explicitly.
Identified request for one variant, USD, and an explicit positive whole-unit quantity.
All undeleted USD base-price rows whose inclusive quantity interval contains the requested quantity, ordered by exact unit cents.
A unique cheapest eligible price and exact subtotal, or an explicit no-price or ambiguous-price result. It is not a committed sale.
Nonnegative canonical major-unit decimal string with at most two fractional digits, converted losslessly to UInt64 cents.
Selected unit cents times unit quantity, rejecting UInt64 overflow; excludes tax, shipping and adjustments.
